notes:
{社会|しゃかい} means society and also refers to the school subject social studies.

TWO MEANINGS:
1. Society: ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧{社会|しゃかい} (modern society)
2. Social studies: {社会|しゃかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (social studies test)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧: working adult, member of society

- ⟦{社会科|しゃかいか}→社会科：noentry⟧: social studies (as a subject)
- ⟦{社会問題|しゃかいもんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧: social issue

- ⟦{社会福祉|しゃかいふくし}→社会福祉：noentry⟧: social welfare
